annotation.summary: One astronaut discovers a truth that the other already knew.
annotation.visual: Two astronauts look at Earth from space. The astronaut behind the surprised observer points a gun at them.
annotation.mechanism: A dramatic revelation is answered with calm confirmation that the supposedly new truth was true all along.
scenarios: Discover an automated workflow has always been operated manually
Realize a polished dashboard is a spreadsheet underneath
Learn that a supposedly temporary workaround has become permanent
roles: First astronaut: person discovering the truth
Second astronaut: insider who already knows

examples.why: The discovery changes the observer's understanding, while the insider treats it as old news.

avoid: Do not present invented dialogue as a quote from the original source.
annotation.basis: Creative interpretation based on inspected source media; not a verified account of historical origin.
